from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from decimal import Decimal
import hashlib,json,time,requests,math
OUT=Path("reports/research/510300_bank_accepted_bill_discount_source_qualification_v1")
DATES=("2022-01-04","2025-12-31")
URL="http://www.shcpe.com.cn/shcpe-cos/yield/mark"
PROTO=json.loads((OUT/"protocol.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert PROTO["historical_scope"]==["2022-01-01","2025-12-31"]
assert PROTO["new_fits"]==0 and PROTO["new_accounts"]==0
assert not (OUT/"historical_curve_sample_receipts.json").exists()
assert not (OUT/"04_历史日期查询开始.json").exists()
prior_receipts=[]
for name in ("catalog_receipts.json","public_script_receipts.json"):
    prior_receipts.extend(json.loads((OUT/name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
assert len(prior_receipts)==6
assert 6+len(DATES)<=PROTO["additional_official_requests_budget"]
def now():
    return datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def save(name,obj):
    p=OUT/name
    assert not p.exists(),f"禁止覆盖已有记录：{p}"
    p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
save("04_历史日期查询开始.json",{
    "started_at":now(),"dates":list(DATES),"curve_code":"001","tenor":"6M",
    "read_only_api":URL,"source_script":"sources/shcpe-inner.js","source_method":"loadYCuver",
    "prior_additional_requests":6,"this_batch_additional_requests":2,"remaining_after_this_batch":4,
    "date_selection":"冻结范围的首个常规工作日与末日；不按股票收益选择",
    "new_equity_labels":0,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0,"repository_source_code_edits":0
})
def probe(date):
    stamp=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai"))
    payload={"requestTime":stamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),"requestSystem":"shcpe-cos",
        "requestNo":int(time.time()*1000),"curveCode":"001","staticsTime":date}
    receipt={"requested_at":stamp.isoformat(),"requested_date":date,"url":URL,"method":"POST",
        "read_only_endpoint":True,"request_json":payload,"attempts":1}
    try:
        response=requests.post(URL,json=payload,headers={
            "User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0","Content-Type":"application/json;charset=UTF-8",
            "Referer":"http://www.shcpe.com.cn/content/shcpe/market.html"
        },timeout=(10,25),stream=True)
        receipt.update({"status_code":response.status_code,"final_url":response.url,
            "content_type":response.headers.get("Content-Type"),"server_date":response.headers.get("Date")})
        chunks=[]; size=0
        for chunk in response.iter_content(65536):
            size+=len(chunk)
            if size>524288: raise ValueError("响应超过固定512KiB样例预算")
            chunks.append(chunk)
        raw=b"".join(chunks)
        response.close()
        path=OUT/"sources"/("curve_001_"+date+"_response.bin")
        assert not path.exists()
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        receipt.update({"path":str(path).replace("\\","/"),"bytes":len(raw),
            "sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"successfully_received":True})
        try:
            body=json.loads(raw)
            receipt["response_code"]=body.get("code") if isinstance(body,dict) else None
            receipt["response_message"]=body.get("msg",body.get("message")) if isinstance(body,dict) else None
            receipt["top_level_keys"]=list(body) if isinstance(body,dict) else []
            data=body.get("data") if isinstance(body,dict) else None
            receipt["data_type"]=type(data).__name__
            if isinstance(data,dict):
                receipt["data_keys"]=list(data)
                receipt["returned_date"]=data.get("stsDate")
                rows=data.get("dataList")
                receipt["returned_row_count"]=len(rows) if isinstance(rows,list) else None
                candidates=[row for row in rows if isinstance(row,dict) and row.get("duration")=="6M"] if isinstance(rows,list) else []
                receipt["six_month_rows"]=candidates
                receipt["same_requested_date"]=data.get("stsDate")==date
                receipt["sample_field_located"]=str(body.get("code"))=="000" and len(candidates)==1 and receipt["same_requested_date"]
            else: receipt["sample_field_located"]=False
        except (ValueError,TypeError) as error:
            receipt["json_parse_error"]=str(error)
            receipt["sample_field_located"]=False
    except Exception as error:
        receipt.update({"successfully_received":False,"error_type":type(error).__name__,
            "error":str(error),"sample_field_located":False})
    receipt["completed_at"]=now()
    return receipt
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    receipts=list(pool.map(probe,DATES))
save("historical_curve_sample_receipts.json",receipts)
save("historical_curve_sample_summary.json",{
    "completed_at":now(),"samples_requested":len(DATES),
    "samples_with_exact_date_and_6M":sum(bool(x.get("sample_field_located")) for x in receipts),
    "additional_requests_used_total":8,"additional_requests_remaining":4,
    "continuous_2022_2025_coverage_established":False,"historical_publication_clock_established":False,
    "new_equity_labels":0,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0,"goal_achieved":False
})
for row in receipts:
    print(json.dumps({key:row.get(key) for key in ("requested_date","status_code","response_code",
        "response_message","returned_date","six_month_rows","sample_field_located","error_type")},ensure_ascii=False))
